text:
The photograph shows a top-down view of a square white translucent plastic enclosure or plate, filling most of the frame, with a raised rim around its edge. The recessed interior surface is milky white and appears backlit, brighter toward the centre.

Eight metal screws sit flush in the panel: four near the corners of the inner area and four arranged in a square closer to the middle.

At the centre is a small square white component with a 4x4 grid of raised round bumps or pins, surrounded by a faint grey shadow visible through the translucent surface.

On the left edge, a dark grey or black rectangular block with a pale diamond marking is mounted, along with two lighter clips or tabs above and below it. A grey metal surface is visible at the far left.
